notes: NOTE: (1) For materials whose strength has been enhanced by heat treatment or by strain hardening, the criteria shown shall govern unless the values are lower than for material whose strength is not enhanced by heat treatment or strain hard- ening, in which case the values for the material whose strength has not been enhanced by heat treatment or strain hard- ening shall be used.
